#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Captive portal for the lab firewall (stands in for coova-chilli, which the node image's Debian lacks).

  nb-portal --listen IP:PORT --radius HOST[:PORT] --secret SECRET [--table "inet filter"] [--log FILE]

GET / serves the login form. POST /login (user, password) sends a RADIUS Access-Request with radclient;
on Access-Accept the client's address is added to the nft set `portal_<policy>`, where <policy> is the
Filter-Id the RADIUS server returned for that user (default `staff`). The firewall's rules decide what
each set may reach. Every attempt is logged as one JSON line: user, client, RADIUS verdict, policy."""
import argparse
import http.server
import json
import re
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.parse

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--listen", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--radius", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--secret", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--table", default="inet filter")
ap.add_argument("--log", default="/var/log/nb-portal.jsonl")
a = ap.parse_args()
host, port = a.listen.rsplit(":", 1)
radius = a.radius if ":" in a.radius else a.radius + ":1812"
FORM = b"<form method=post action=/login>user <input name=user> password <input name=password type=password>" \
       b" <input type=submit></form>\n"


def authenticate(user, password):
    req = f'User-Name = "{user}"\nUser-Password = "{password}"\n'
    p = subprocess.run(["radclient", "-x", "-r", "1", "-t", "3", radius, "auth", a.secret],
                       input=req, capture_output=True, text=True)
    out = p.stdout + p.stderr
    # on a reject radclient also prints "Expected Access-Accept got Access-Reject": read the reply line
    m = re.search(r"Received (Access-Accept|Access-Reject)", out)
    verdict = m.group(1) if m else "no-reply"
    m = re.search(r'Filter-Id = "([\w-]+)"', out)
    return verdict, (m.group(1) if m else "staff")


class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *_):
        pass

    def _send(self, code, body):
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._send(200, FORM)

    def do_POST(self):
        form = urllib.parse.parse_qs(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)).decode())
        user, password = form.get("user", [""])[0], form.get("password", [""])[0]
        client = self.client_address[0]
        verdict, policy = authenticate(user, password)
        if verdict == "Access-Accept":
            subprocess.run(["nft", "add", "element", *a.table.split(), f"portal_{policy}", "{", client, "}"],
                           capture_output=True)
        with open(a.log, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps({"ts": time.time(), "user": user, "client": client, "radius": verdict,
                                "policy": policy if verdict == "Access-Accept" else None}) + "\n")
        self._send(200, (f"accepted policy={policy}\n" if verdict == "Access-Accept" else f"rejected ({verdict})\n").encode())


http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer((host, int(port)), H).serve_forever()
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Captive portal for the lab firewall (stands in for coova-chilli, which the node image's Debian lacks).

  nb-portal --listen IP:PORT --radius HOST[:PORT] --secret SECRET [--table "inet filter"] [--log FILE]

GET / serves the login form. POST /login (user, password) sends a RADIUS Access-Request with radclient;
on Access-Accept the client's address is added to the nft set `portal_<policy>`, where <policy> is the
Filter-Id the RADIUS server returned for that user (default `staff`). The firewall's rules decide what
each set may reach. Every attempt is logged as one JSON line: user, client, RADIUS verdict, policy."""
import argparse
import http.server
import json
import re
import subprocess
import time
import urllib.parse

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--listen", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--radius", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--secret", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--table", default="inet filter")
ap.add_argument("--log", default="/var/log/nb-portal.jsonl")
a = ap.parse_args()
host, port = a.listen.rsplit(":", 1)
radius = a.radius if ":" in a.radius else a.radius + ":1812"
FORM = b"<form method=post action=/login>user <input name=user> password <input name=password type=password>" \
       b" <input type=submit></form>\n"


def authenticate(user, password):
    req = f'User-Name = "{user}"\nUser-Password = "{password}"\n'
    p = subprocess.run(["radclient", "-x", "-r", "1", "-t", "3", radius, "auth", a.secret],
                       input=req, capture_output=True, text=True)
    out = p.stdout + p.stderr
    # on a reject radclient also prints "Expected Access-Accept got Access-Reject": read the reply line
    m = re.search(r"Received (Access-Accept|Access-Reject)", out)
    verdict = m.group(1) if m else "no-reply"
    m = re.search(r'Filter-Id = "([\w-]+)"', out)
    return verdict, (m.group(1) if m else "staff")


class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *_):
        pass

    def _send(self, code, body):
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._send(200, FORM)

    def do_POST(self):
        form = urllib.parse.parse_qs(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)).decode())
        user, password = form.get("user", [""])[0], form.get("password", [""])[0]
        client = self.client_address[0]
        verdict, policy = authenticate(user, password)
        if verdict == "Access-Accept":
            subprocess.run(["nft", "add", "element", *a.table.split(), f"portal_{policy}", "{", client, "}"],
                           capture_output=True)
        with open(a.log, "a") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps({"ts": time.time(), "user": user, "client": client, "radius": verdict,
                                "policy": policy if verdict == "Access-Accept" else None}) + "\n")
        self._send(200, (f"accepted policy={policy}\n" if verdict == "Access-Accept" else f"rejected ({verdict})\n").encode())


http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer((host, int(port)), H).serve_forever()
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1

- **Forward rules:**
  - Established and related traffic is accepted.
  - LAN to internet (eth1 to eth2) is accepted for addresses in `portal_staff`.
  - For addresses in `portal_web`, only TCP 80 and 443 are accepted.
  - Everything else is dropped, so unauthenticated LAN hosts have no internet access.
- **Redirect:** LAN HTTP (port 80) from hosts not yet in either set is redirected to the portal. Unauthenticated HTTPS isn't redirected. It is simply dropped, so users need to browse to a plain-HTTP page or go straight to `http://192.168.10.1:8080` to get the login form.
- **Not persisted:** The nft changes are live only. I didn't write them to a config file, so they will be lost on reboot.
